import io

import polars as pl

df = pl.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": [1, 2, 3, 4],
        "name": ["alice", "bob", "carol", "dave"],
        "score": [91.5, 82.3, 77.8, 95.1],
    }
)

buffer = io.BytesIO()
df.write_parquet(buffer)

buffer.seek(0)
df_roundtrip = pl.read_parquet(buffer)

assert df.equals(df_roundtrip)
print(df_roundtrip)
